results.question: Where were the Germanic tribes originally located?

retrieved_memories.memory: Germanic tribes originated from Scandinavia and Northern Europe
Germanic tribes expanded into Southern Europe in late antiquity
Germanic tribes conquered Celtic and other peoples
Germanic tribes expanded throughout Northern and Western Europe in the middle period of classical antiquity
By 800 CE, Germanic tribes formed the Holy Roman Empire, the first German Empire
By 1000 CE, the Germanic conquest of Central, Western, and Southern Europe was complete, excluding only Muslim Iberia
Germany remained largely a conceptual term referring to an amorphous area of Central Europe
There was little cultural integration or national identity in the Holy Roman Empire
There was no real systemic continuity from the Western Roman Empire to the Holy Roman Empire
The Holy Roman Empire consisted of a great number of small states and principalities in a loosely autonomous confederation
